prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: dark blue mosaic floor with small gold star and constellation patterns The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map. Entire image edge-to-edge is a dark blue mosaic floor, with small sparse gold stars and fine constellation patterns evenly distributed, not a focal feature. Truly periodic edges: left seamlessly continues right, top seamlessly continues bottom, including mosaic joints and constellation lines. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art JRPG look, hand-placed pixel clusters of 3–10 uniform-size crisp square art pixels. Consistent coarse pixel grid across whole image, each art pixel rendered as approximately 7–8 by 7–8 screen pixels; absolutely no anti-aliasing, blur, gradient, photographic texture, random pixel noise, or checkerboard dithering. Distinct clear shapes, 4–6 shades per material, dark midnight blue and indigo stone tiles with saturated purple-red shadows and restrained warm yellow gold highlights; rich earthy slightly worn surface. Orthographic straight overhead map texture without perspective. Neutral even soft upper-left illumination, clean base colors, no cast shadows, no glow, no lamps, no vignette, no nighttime darkening. No border, frame, characters, objects, writing, or text. Square composition.
